chunks: Whatever is in it from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih, I have transmitted it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the immediate transmitter in the author’s sanad/isnad.
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ: A transmitter in the chain through whom the report passes.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a statement indicating the author’s mode of transmission.
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A transmitter in the chain of narration.
key_terms.شِهَابِ بْنِ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ: A narrator from whom reports in this section are transmitted.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain for Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Shihab ibn Abd Rabbih in the book. It serves as a chain-of-transmission notice, identifying the narrators through whom the author received these hadith.
